message:
test(apk): C r2's negative contrasts -- Codex's N1-a / N3 counterexamples that build against 5fe90a9 and fail there; a publish held open from a third thread (S9); a covered-exhausted sink keeps a pipeline cause; an absent DebugStatus field is not a pass (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r2)

Tests only, no product file.
- decoder_chain_inbox_r2_contrast_test (new, pure): written with only the API r1 and r2 share (Offer / Pop / one-argument
  MarkLoss), so the same file builds against 5fe90a9's decoder_chain_inbox.hpp (REMOTE60_CHAIN_INBOX_DIR): N1-a delta12,
  delta13, IDR14 + a loss at 11 -> the first Pop is IDR14; N3 seq 100 then 40 x seq 99 -> none admitted. 5fe90a9: both
  FAIL (first=12 key=0; admitted=1). This source: 2/2.
- android_decoder_inbox_session_test [S9] rewritten: the publish comes from the TEST thread (the control thread's own
  sink-want publish can never race its own scheduler -- the first S9 could not tell a split section); held open 400 ms
  inside it: one section -> nothing cancelled, the host gets the ask (401 ms); the split-section mutant -> cancelled.
- android_decoder_inbox_c_test: [C11] + covered-exhausted leaves a pipeline cause valid (Codex §8 "유효 pipeline 원인
  유지"); [C10] chainTrim must be PRESENT (5fe90a9 has no such field and field() read it as the maximum).
- CMake: the contrast target.

Negative runs (neg\<name>, each its own build dir; c_neg_run.ps1): 5fe90a9 -> contrast 2 FAIL, inbox_c C9 + C11 (6 FAIL);
the session test does not build there (new header). Single-fix mutants of this source: no_trim (pure 3, contrast, C10),
no_keycommit (pure), no_keyoutside + no_keycommit (C9; each alone is covered by the other), no_consume + empty_legacy
(S5; each alone is covered by the other), held_clear_all (S6), publish_split (S9), no_exhaust_notice (S8 2).
